messages:
Maria (runtime): Heads-up — planning a focused soak to catch KV cache edge regressions + failure-mode behavior this weekend. Want to run a traffic replay at ~75% qps for 6h, then a 1h burst at 120% to exercise cold fills and KV sharding. Need owners for: dataset, k6 vs Locust, infra cap, alert runbook.
Sam: I can own the k6 scripts. Any specific scenario we should replay (prefix-heavy, long context)?
Maria (runtime): Yes — prioritize prefix-heavy + mixed seq lengths. Primary dataset: recent customer-replay-2026-03 (sanitized). Link: https://internal.artifacts/replays/customer-replay-2026-03
Cheng: I'll take dashboarding/alerts. We'll want token-level latency percentiles + KV hit-rate and mem pressure. Add a regression check: if p99 latency increases >20% vs baseline, auto-tag the run.
Noah: Infra: we have one spare rig group (dedicated-pool-4) but need to toggle autoscale buffer to +30% for the burst window. I can schedule the change but need exact timestamps.
Olivia: Quick code-review ping — I left a small fix in PR #4217 to ensure trace propagation during replay. If that lands after 12:00 PT Fri it won't make the run. Can we target merge by EOD Thu?
Maria (runtime): Proposed schedule: Sat 02:00 PT start; 6h steady at 75% -> 08:00 PT, then 1h burst until 09:00 PT, then 30m cool-down. Noah — please set autoscale buffer 01:45-09:30 PT.
Sam: k6 config draft (quick):
```
--vus 200
--duration 6h
--rps 1500
--stages [ {duration: '1h', target: 1500}, {duration: '1h', target: 1500} ]
```
I'll attach CPU/mem throttling flags so we capture failure modes.
Cheng: Dashboard widgets I need: p50/p95/p99 token latency, KV hit-rate, OOM counts, gc pause, connection queue length. Also link to perf baseline: https://dash.internal/perf/baseline/kv-cache/march.
Maria (runtime): For regression gating: create an artifact with a short summary and perf diff. If p99 diff > +20% or KV hit-rate drops >15%, we abort and collect heap + metrics. Cheng — can you automate the perf diff?
Cheng: Yes. I'll add a small job that pulls baseline and runs a delta comparison; will post a pass/fail tag in the thread.
Noah: Autoscale buffer set and reserved nodes pinned. I also scheduled a warmup deploy to populate KV shards 30m before start. Will post logs if anything weird.
cd-deploy-bot: Deployment "warmup/kv-shards" succeeded on pool dedicated-pool-4 at 2026-03-22T01:25:00Z :white_check_mark:
Olivia: PR #4217 merged. Trace headers include `x-rw-replay-id` now.
Maria (runtime): Nice — final checklist: dataset owner (Sam), load script (Sam), infra (Noah), dashboards/regression (Cheng), traces/PR (Olivia). If anyone can't make their slot, ping now. I'll post a short runbook in #eng-oncall with links.
Sam: I'll post the k6 repo link + raw script by EOD Thu.
Cheng: I'll wire the perf-diff job and add an alert that p99 > 1.2x baseline.
Noah: Will monitor and handle node evictions. If we see >3% eviction rate, we'll pause.
Maria (runtime): Thanks — I'll create the runbook and set the thread to monitoring mode. :thumbsup:
